subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Patterns, functions and algebra: Geometric and number patterns
source.subtopic: Geometric patterns made with objects, drawings of lines and shapes: copy, extend and describe; create and describe own patterns

show.line: Look at this pattern. Circle, circle, square. Circle, circle, square. Two circles, then a square. It repeats!

rounds.prompt: Circle, circle, square, circle, circle. Which shape comes next?
Triangle, star, star, triangle, star, star. Which shape comes next?
Big, small, big, small, big. Say what comes next.
Red square, blue square, gap, blue square. Which square is missing?
Which beads make a pattern that repeats?
rounds.praise: Yes! Blue, blue, yellow, again and again.

rounds.prompt: Does the line pattern go up and down, or round and round? Put each one in its group.

hints: Say the pattern out loud. Find the part that repeats.
Look at where the pattern starts again.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Circle, circle, square, circle, circle. I will say what comes next.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two circles, then a square. Square comes next.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Circle, circle, square. Circle, circle, square!

parent_line: Can copy, continue and describe a repeating shape pattern.
